newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly firmer, gas oil weaker.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly firmer, gas oil weaker.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly firmer on Wednesday, traders said.
Gas oil prices slid 50 cents a tonne but premiums were stable. The French oil workers' strike supported heating oil cargo premiums.
Naphtha swaps were lifted by gasoline's strength and cargoes fell after Algeria's Skikda port reopened.
Gasoline barges rose $4 after a sharp NYMEX rally Tuesday kept the arbitrage open and the strike by Elf refinery works kept supplies tight.
Fuel oil remained firm supported by high and low sulphur tenders and the continued French strike.
